student_id.description: A laminated pub receipt cosplaying as academic credentials. Honored as identification exactly nowhere. All three say 22.

aa_prize_paraffin_pucker.description: Red wax lips that taste like a birthday candle somebody else blew out. Lord Pilsner wore them for a full lap of the bar and logged every turned cheek as "a near miss."

aa_prize_fangs_for_nothing.effect: Cosmetic: while equipped, the wearer's battle shouts are lisped ("Thmaaaash!"). No stats.
aa_prize_fangs_for_nothing.description: Glow-in-the-dark vampire teeth one size too large for any human jaw. Bradley has worn them through two drinks and a pickup line and describes the night as "dangerous."

aa_prize_sixty_minute_emerald.effect: Cosmetic status Jade Knuckle after 60 in-game minutes worn. No stat change. Chadwick cites it as proof of authenticity in dialogue.
aa_prize_sixty_minute_emerald.description: A gold-tone ring with a green glass stone the size of a cocktail olive. After an hour the finger underneath matches the stone, which Chadwick says is how you know it's real.

aa_prize_five_finger_lint_discount.description: A sticky rubber hand on a three-foot leash, already furred with bar-floor hair, a ticket stub and one curly hair nobody will claim. Bradley slaps it on the bar whenever he wants another round and calls this "ordering."

aa_prize_pinky_promise_prison.description: A woven paper tube that tightens the harder you pull. Chadwick and Bradley got their fingers stuck in opposite ends and have been asking the bartender for the couples' discount.

aa_prize_neon_wrist_guillotine.description: A strip of spring steel in a hot-pink fabric sleeve that snaps around the wrist on impact and through the sleeve by Thursday. Bradley stacks it under his other bracelets and calls the set his "armor."

aa_prize_fuchsia_foot_of_fortune.description: A rabbit's foot dyed a pink no living rabbit ever reached, on a keychain that clearly did nothing for the rabbit. Chadwick clipped it to his chain wallet and rubs it before every claw-machine attempt.

aa_prize_sobriety_test_deluxe.effect: Usable from inventory. Always fails while the user is Drunk or Confused (tilt rattle, no result). Solvable sober, for no reward.
aa_prize_sobriety_test_deluxe.description: A palm-sized plastic maze with three silver balls and one hole, unsolvable after the second absinthe. Lord Pilsner has been working on it since eleven and says he is "one tilt away."

aa_prize_sit_down_comedy_special.effect: Battle item, once per battle, never consumed: 35% chance to inflict Embarrassed on one enemy. On a miss, the bros claim it hit.
aa_prize_sit_down_comedy_special.description: A pink rubber whoopee cushion priced like a used scooter. Bradley calls it "the strongest weapon in the building" and has deployed it on every bar stool, including the bidet.

aa_prize_flamingo_hydro_bro_2000.effect: Field interaction: squirt an NPC for a one-line reaction. No battle use.
aa_prize_flamingo_hydro_bro_2000.description: A flamingo-pink pump-action squirt gun that holds one shot glass of liquid and leaks a second. Chadwick filled it with absinthe and calls it his "concealed carry."

aa_prize_highlighter_hydro_bro_2000.effect: Field interaction: squirt an NPC for a one-line reaction. No battle use.
aa_prize_highlighter_hydro_bro_2000.description: The same squirt gun in highlighter yellow, won separately because Lord Pilsner refused to share a weapons platform with Chadwick. It holds beer. It does not hold it well.

aa_prize_two_grand_tie_dye_tee.description: A one-size-fits-nobody tie-dye shirt printed slightly crooked with I ♥ ABSINTHE ARCADE. Bradley wears it over his jersey and calls it his "championship belt."

aa_prize_chuck_e_cheese_plush.description: A cross-eyed plush pizza rat in a chef's hat, stuffed with what feels like aquarium gravel and smelling like a ball pit. Lord Pilsner handed over two and a half thousand tickets for it and calls it "the crown jewels."

sea_monkeys.description:
A high-contrast, aggressively compressed 48x48 pixel GIF of the classic 1990s comic book ad illustration—two excessively smiling, human-faced aquatic royalty figures wearing golden crowns, swimming triumphantly through what appears to be a glass bowl of murky tap water laced with green algae and unexploded nutrient powder.

The animation consists of exactly four jerky frames where their eyes dilate in terrifying unison while a faint, low-bitrate MIDI file of the Saved by the Bell theme song plays on an infinite loop. It was minted on an abandoned side-chain whose block explorer is currently a dead link to a GeoCities guestbook. It is worth 0 SOVS at every bank, pawn shop, and shady back-alley terminal in Debaucheryville, permanently and by design.

aa_claw_pre_emptive_perry.description: A camo bear whose plastic pellets feel suspiciously like depleted uranium.

poem: Perry searches near and far,
For hidden weapons in the jar.
He found no yellowcake today,
So now in Europe he will stay!

aa_claw_pets_con_sock_hound.description: A plush sock puppet whose IPO valuation dropped ninety-eight percent before the stuffing settled.

poem: Super Bowl ads cost a lot,
Now an empty parking lot.
Hug this dog with all your might,
His burn rate peaked on Tuesday night!

aa_claw_snorty_bouncer_badger.description: His snout has a permanent crust of baby laxative and unresolved nightclub hostility.

poem: Snorty grinds his plushy jaws,
White residue on velvet paws.
Keep him away from bathroom stalls,
He’s pacing up and down the walls!

aa_claw_mugshot_mandy.description: A Chihuahua whose rhinestone collar carries two active bench warrants and a sticky smear of lip gloss.

poem: Low-rise velour, no underwear,
Flashbulbs blinding in the air.
Lost her license, kept the fame,
Nobody can pronounce her name!

aa_claw_minty_rare_mint_bunny.description: Still trapped in a yellowed acrylic display cube with a sun-bleached Certificate of Authenticity.

poem: Keep my plastic tag attached,
A fortune waiting to be hatched.
Divorce courts had to split my fleece,
Three thousand SOVS for one piece!

aa_junk_terminal_velocity_terry.description: A tangled tangle of green plastic that promises high-altitude heroism and delivers a direct face-plant into bar slop.

aa_junk_forty_eight_hour_tramp_stamp.description: A sheet of barbed-wire tribal designs applied with warm beer and removed by twenty minutes of aggressive sweating.

aa_junk_noise_violation.description: Neon-orange molded plastic without a pea. It produces a shrill, piercing squeal calibrated to trigger immediate bar-staff homicide.

aa_junk_promise_ish_ring.description: A jewel of uncertain plastic origin. Makes your finger look 4% wealthier.

candy_smokes.effect: Usable from inventory by any bro, never used up: +2 Bravado to the user for 60 seconds (does not stack with itself). While it lasts he offers one to every NPC he talks to; nobody accepts. Leaves a chalk ring on his mouth. +1 Charm with children only.
candy_smokes.description: A carton of children's candy cigarettes, the exact supply Aaron the Unflappable was running on at one in the morning, worn soft from several thousand openings and not one stick less full. The bros say you can't get these back home, they banned them, which tells you something. That's not candy, bro. That's his thing. It does not light. They have tried.

members_card.effect: Satisfies the Black-Tie Attire requirement at the Backroom door. The +3 Charm or +3 Bravado door check and the 500 SOVS collateral still apply in full. Backroom staff greet the party on sight (+1 Charm with Backroom staff only). Accepted at no other door in the game.
members_card.description: Black plastic, no name, no number, no expiry, cut in batches for anyone who has moved about 1,000 SOVS across the Backroom's tables, won or lost. The note with it says the house would be glad of your company again, which is true. Lord Pilsner says they're on a list now, a short one, somewhere in that building, and he would honestly try it at an airport.

tractor_nft.effect: Counts as one of the sixteen Frat Bro NFT collection targets (Sinfonia's fourth). Examining it opens an expired Geocities page, autoplays a MIDI and adds one to a hit counter that starts at 000019. Worth 0 SOVS everywhere; cannot be sold, dropped or traded.
tractor_nft.description:
A scratched, unplated aluminum token roughly the shape and weight of a discarded beer bottle cap, bearing a stamped QR code on one face and **MINT #42** on the reverse. It smells permanently and inexplicably of Kahlúa, cheap stale beer, and fresh-cut grass.

Scanning it on the party’s phone loads an expired 2003 Geocities fansite dedicated entirely to top-down country music ringtones, featuring a grey background, a broken-image icon of a cowboy boot, a hit counter reading **000019**, and an unstoppable MIDI loop of a synthetic banjo. The underlying digital asset is an 11-frame looping GIF of a zero-turn mower executing a clean donut on a manicured horse country pasture, complete with a tiny pixelated cowboy hat bouncing slightly out of sync on the seat. It is worth **0 SOVS** at every bank, pawnshop, and back-alley terminal across Sinfonia and Debaucheryville, permanently and by design.

millennium_bug.description: A brutally compressed 16-bit digital artifact scraped straight from a bathroom stall graffiti tag behind the red velvet ropes of the Velvet Curtain Club. The asset depicts a glowing green, pixelated 1990s desktop computer bug wearing a tiny party hat, twitching and crying under a pixelated party noisemaker as two digits roll over from '99' to '00'. It is permanently valued at **0 SOVS** across every bank, ledger, and black-market terminal in Debaucheryville, but its psychological value to the bros is immeasurable.

hamagotchi_consolation.description: A waterlogged knockoff Tamagotchi with Hamstradamus's face decaled on the shell, delivered to the hostel door for losing. The buttons are corroded solid and the screen has shown the same flickering hamster ghost since 2003. The bros call it the oldest piece of technology any of them has ever owned. Don't touch it. You'll mess up the ghost.

auto_gratuity_receipt.description: 18% service charge, added for your convenience. The service was you.

fuzzy_dice_of_doubt.description: Unloaded. They roll whatever you were already going to do.

shell_company_business_card.description: Registered at an address that turns out to be a fax machine in a turtle.

jakub_tokens_flair_pin.description: A dented tin badge crusty with dried anise and teenage acne sebum. Pinned onto twenty-three shirts before this one; fourteen of those guys died of liver failure behind the DDR cabinet.

item_broken_symbol_game_boy.description: A scratched gray handheld console whose dead screen briefly displays unfamiliar musical symbols when held near an arcade mirror.

bottle_opener_keychain.description: for opening beers with maximum jingling and zero class

brewery_passport_book.description:
A heavy, faux-leather-bound pocket ledger featuring a hop-leaf bookmark and a debossed cover that reads **THE CONTINENTAL BEER TRAIL**. Handed over by establishment staff in Publandia alongside the keychain the exact microsecond the bros order their first special beer, the book is pristine, un-inked, and terrifyingly official.

Inside, it contains hyper-bureaucratic stamp-slot pages for every city, complete with ornate security borders, regional color palettes, and empty grid spaces designed to turn casual daytime drinking into a compliance audit.

participant_wristband.description: SUBJECT 0417. ALLERGIES: NONE KNOWN. DO NOT RESUSCITATE WITHOUT CONSENT FORM.
